scene_frontend.theme_title: MiniMax H3 Video Loop [Upload one video to generate a seamless loop]

prompt.Basic:
subject_definitions:
The existing subjects and environment retain their source appearance and visual style.

summary:
[video continuation + keyframe completion] Continue from the source video's ending state into its opening state through one continuous audiovisual passage, completing a seamless loop.

retention_analysis:
Preserve subject identity, clothing, objects, scene layout, lighting and camera perspective. Develop the outgoing motion into the incoming motion through a physically connected path.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] The exact final state of the source ending continues directly into this passage without stopping, retaining each subject's position, support, orientation, facing, momentum and contacts. Guide the subjects and camera through a natural progression toward the source opening. Keep existing camera tracking tied to the action's direction and speed; preserve a stationary viewpoint when the source camera is stationary. Retain consistent proportions, textures, lighting and background geometry as positions change. Match the opening pose, movement direction, speed and framing at the end of the passage so the original action can continue without a jump. Keep motion developing throughout the available time, without freezing early, teleporting, reversing playback or repeating the original clip. Add no unrelated scene, new subject or captions.

overall_soundscape:
Continue the existing ambience and synchronized sounds through the passage toward the source opening, retaining their character and timing. Do not invent dialogue.

non_diegetic_music:
Continue any existing source music naturally toward the opening; do not introduce an unrelated score.

agent_prompt.Basic: Write an H3 loop-completion prompt using the six sections subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis, detailed_description, overall_soundscape and non_diegetic_music. Both chronological contact sheets come from the same video: its tail is the starting state and its head is the ending state. They are analysis-only evidence, never numbered Picture or Video references. The workflow supplies native endpoint conditions and source-motion context. Separately uploaded pictures are optional references numbered as <Picture N> using only the supplied inventory; empty slots do not consume a number. Describe each picture's requested contribution within the new passage while preserving both source boundaries. Describe only the new continuous passage returning from the source ending to its opening. The requested duration is the added passage, not the full source or final output. Infer each subject's position, support, orientation, facing, momentum and contacts at both ends; connect those states through purposeful physical motion while matching identity, scene, camera direction, framing and lighting. The final state must lead directly into the source opening without an early freeze, abrupt reset, reverse playback or repeated source action. Use one continuous shot unless the user explicitly requests otherwise. Integrate camera movement and synchronized sounds into natural shot prose. The source soundtracks are timed boundary conditions, not numbered audio references. You see pictures, not audible audio; follow user-provided sound and dialogue requirements without inventing unheard words, instruments or melodies. Preserve any requested dialogue in its original language as audio-only speech; add no captions unless requested. Do not introduce an unrelated scene or music. Keep implementation details, cropping, masks, latents and padding out of the generation prompt.
